response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack and distributed-systems experience, including event-driven architectures and real-time systems, with leadership roles in scale-ups. However, his background lacks direct fintech or credit-risk expertise, and his agentic-AI experience appears limited to emerging MCP/tooling rather than production multi-agent systems. His open-source work is notable but not aligned with high-stakes fintech compliance or financial modeling.
strengths: Proven backend and distributed-systems expertise (event streaming, microservices, real-time systems)
Leadership experience scaling engineering teams and establishing technical governance frameworks
Strong open-source contributions and polyglot engineering skills (D, TypeScript, Node.js)
concerns: No demonstrated production experience with multi-agent AI systems or fintech infrastructure (credit risk, working-capital management)
Limited exposure to regulated environments with financial or operational consequences
Agentic-AI work appears theoretical or tooling-focused rather than operational systems
